facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT and Innovation says about Rwf935.7 million in early-stage startup funding has been approved under the Rwanda Digital Acceleration Project, with startups applying through Hanga Venture Ignite for up to $50,000 or $100,000.

systems.tiers: tier 1 up to $50,000; tier 2 up to $100,000

RWA.note: Grants to ESOs stated, but no incubation programme with a cohort named.
